content.text: The final round of group fixtures will see Nigeria face Algeria and Tunisia take on Botswana on Sunday, with both games kicking off at 19:00 GMT.
As both teams are considered favorites to win the new Wafcon trophy in three weeks, it was anticipated that this match would provide an exciting kickoff to the tournament.
Di Nigeria squad list for di 2024 Wafcon get a combination of both old and young players.
Nigeria is a formidable team in continental football, having secured the Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) title nine times.
